# Noise_Robustness_Benchmarking

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A systematic evaluation methodology that injects controlled perturbations (e.g., synaptic or spike noise) into neuromorphic systems to measure degradation in recall or classification accuracy. This provides a quantitative basis for comparing the resilience of different TCC/iNEST topologies under realistic hardware noise conditions.
